rules.description: Tipos internos del WordPress expuestos por query string (/?cms_block=…) a la home
rules.expression: (http.host eq "hisoil.com.ar" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and (http.request.uri.query contains "cms_block=" or http.request.uri.query contains "elementor_library=" or http.request.uri.query contains "taxonomy=" or http.request.uri.query contains "woodmart_slide=" or http.request.uri.query contains "portfolio=" or http.request.uri.query contains "project-cat="))
